Km. Rehana @ Riya And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. on 19
January, 2023

Author: Manju Rani Chauhan
Bench: Manju Rani Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2832 of 2021
Applicant :- Km. Rehana @ Riya And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Aditya Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
1.
List revised.
No one has appeared on behalf of the applicants to press this application.

Mr. K.P.
Pathak, learned A.G.A. for the State is present.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in Case Crime No.362 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Sadar Bazar, District-Shahjahanpur, with the prayer that in the event of arrest, applicants may be released on anticipatory bail.
3.
On 12.02.2021, the following order was passed:-
"Implication of the applicants under the alleged offences appears to be on account of matrimonial dispute.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the allegations made are absolutely false.
They have been made for ulterior motives and to pressurize the applicants.
Counsel for the applicants is permitted to implead the informant as opposite party no. 2.
In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicants.

Km. Rehana @ Riya And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102845581/
2

entities.text: Km. Rehana @ Riya And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Investigating Officer will continue with the investigation and will not be affected by this order.

A copy of this order downloaded from the official website of this court shall also be produced before the S.S.P concerned by the applicants who shall ensure compliance of this order after due verification from official website of this court.''
4.
On the basis of instructions learned A.G.A. submits that dispute is matrimonial in nature wherein entire family of the husband has been roped with false and frivolous allegations.
He further submits that charge sheet has been submitted in this matter.
He further submits that applicants have always co-operated in the investigation and have not misused the liberty of aforesaid interim anticipatory bail, which was granted to them on 12.02.2021.

5. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicants, the applicants are liable to to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicants shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
6. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.
